text.en:
The sum of one hundred thousand pesos appropriated for the locust campaign by Act Numbered
Thirty-two hundred and seventeen, entitled "An Act appropriating funds for the necessary expenses of the
Government of the Philippine Islands during the fiscal year aiding December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and
twenty-five, and for other purposes," shall be disbursed by the Director of Agriculture, subject to the approval
of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, for the following purposes, and for no others, any
provision of said Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and seventeen to the contrary notwithstanding:
(a) For salaries, wages, and travel and subsistence expenses, when necessary, for the purpose of discovering
and exterminating the locusts and their eggs in their breeding places or wherever they may be in any part of
the Philippine Islands: Provided, That the salaries, wages, and travel expenses shall be payable only when the
extermination of locusts is carried on in isolated and remote places ;
(b) For the purchase of chemicals, apparatus, and other articles, material, and technical equipment; the
purchase of camping equipment for the men, such as tentage and kitchen utensils; and
(c) To defray the expense of research work carried on for the purpose of discovering more efficient and
economic means of exterminating the locusts.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, October 19, 1925.
